title: Articulators v0.1 Tool definition
description: Normative shape of a tool registered with window.articulators. The `invoke` implementation is a runtime function and is therefore out of scope for JSON Schema; this schema validates the serializable, agent-facing portion of a tool (name, description, schemas, effects).

name.description: Unqualified tool name, verb-first lowerCamelCase. The registry constructs the qualified name; suppliers MUST NOT include '/' or ':'.

description.description: Agent-facing description: what the tool does and when to use it.

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema 2020-12 for the arguments. Root type MUST be 'object'.

type.description: Root schema type. MUST be 'object' for tool input.

effectHints.description: Safety/effect metadata. REQUIRED on every tool.

mode.description: Hard binary. Reads never mutate observable state.

idempotent.description: Whether repeating the call with the same arguments has the same effect as one call.

confirmation.description: Whether the agent MUST obtain explicit user confirmation before invoking.

destructive.description: Hint: cancels, deletes, or is hard/impossible to reverse.

consequences.description: Short NL description shown at confirmation time. SHOULD be present when confirmation is 'required'.

allOf.description: Any consequential write SHOULD require confirmation; destructive writes MUST.

examples.name: searchHotels
examples.title: Search hotels
examples.description: Search available hotels for a destination and date range.

effects.consequences: Cancels the reservation. Refund depends on the cancellation policy and may be partial or none.
